To resolve the division issue, we should ensure the two series are aligned (have the same divisions) before concatenation. While `DataFrame.__getitem__` already handles alignment when slicing a `Series` from a `DataFrame`, the `Series.corr` method needs similar logic to ensure that `other` (which might be a result of a comparison like `df.payment_type == 2`) is aligned with `self`.
